correctness.rationale: Reflection symmetry plus published uniqueness puts every finite-p critical point on the vertical axis. Direct evaluation of the polygonal surface-area measure gives the stated one-variable objective. Each affine-ratio term has second derivative \(p(p-1)f(a'/a-b'/b)^2\), and one term is strictly convex, so there is a unique minimizer. Exact rational evaluation of the derivative polynomials gives opposite signs at the stated endpoints for \(p=2\) and \(p=3\); the two isolating intervals are disjoint.
